$comment: Durable queue of regulatory change signals emitted by scripts/regulatory-watch.cjs. Append-only: a row is never deleted, only moved new -> promoted | dismissed by scripts/regulatory-triage.cjs, so a dismissal stays on the record. ledgerCandidates is a deterministic host/citation match against regulatory-ledger.json — the entries a human must re-verify — never an inferred one. Promotion into the compliance registry is authored by a human or /domain-oracle, with a citation; no script writes that file.
